definitions.explanation: Describes a person who pursues one course of action with unwavering dedication, without being swayed by distractions. Can be positive (sincere, devoted) or mildly negative (inflexible).

examples.japanese: {一本気|いっぽんぎ}な{性格|せいかく}だ。
{彼|かれ}は{一本気|いっぽんぎ}で{融通|ゆうずう}が{利|き}かない。
{一本気|いっぽんぎ}な{彼女|かのじょ}は{一度|いちど}{決|き}めたら{最後|さいご}まで{貫|つらぬ}く。
examples.english: She's so single-minded that once she decides something, she sees it through to the end.

notes:
Describes someone who pursues one thing wholeheartedly without wavering. Can be positive (dedicated, sincere) or slightly negative (stubborn, inflexible), depending on context. The word literally suggests having one ({一本|いっぽん}) core spirit ({気|き}).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一本気|いっぽんぎ}な{人|ひと}: a single-minded person
- {一本気|いっぽんぎ}な{性格|せいかく}: a straightforward personality
- {一本気|いっぽんぎ}に{進|すす}む: to push forward single-mindedly

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {一途|いちず}: devoted, single-hearted — usually positive; often used about romantic devotion
- {頑固|がんこ}: stubborn — negative connotation; emphasizes unwillingness to change
- {真|ま}っ{直|す}ぐ: straight, honest — focuses on being straightforward and upright
